Q: What are the differences between Galaxy Book6 and Galaxy Book6 Enterprise Edition?
A: The Galaxy Book6 Enterprise Edition is designed specifically to meet enterprise requirements. It features a dedicated color Gray (Mocha), a One Tone keyboard (with a numeric keypad, available only for the 16-inch model), Windows 11 Pro operating system (Clean OS), dTPM (Discrete TPM), Samsung Knox (SecEP), IR camera, and fingerprint security options.
